title: What Are Tariffs and How Do They Work?

cues.text: In 1930, as the Great Depression ravaged the United States,
cues.en: In 1930, as the Great Depression ravaged the United States,
cues.zh: 1930 年，當經濟大蕭條席捲美國之際，

cues.text: President Herbert Hoover made a bold economic decision.
cues.en: President Herbert Hoover made a bold economic decision.
cues.zh: 美國總統胡佛實施 一項大膽的經濟決策。

cues.text: With the goal of supporting American farmers and manufacturers,
cues.en: With the goal of supporting American farmers and manufacturers,
cues.zh: 為了支援美國的農民與製造商，

cues.text: he approved a sweeping 20% tax
cues.en: he approved a sweeping 20% tax
cues.zh: 他批准一項全面性的關稅政策，

cues.text: on all imported agricultural and industrial goods.
cues.en: on all imported agricultural and industrial goods.
cues.zh: 對所有進口的農產品與工業產品 課徵 20% 的關稅。

cues.text: He believed making foreign goods more expensive
cues.en: He believed making foreign goods more expensive
cues.zh: 他認為，提高外國商品的價格，

cues.text: would encourage consumers to buy domestic,
cues.en: would encourage consumers to buy domestic,
cues.zh: 就能鼓勵消費者購買國內產品，

cues.text: thus funneling cash into American businesses and creating more jobs.
cues.en: thus funneling cash into American businesses and creating more jobs.
cues.zh: 讓資金流入美國企業， 進而創造更多工作機會。

cues.text: But Hoover's plan completely backfired.
cues.en: But Hoover's plan completely backfired.
cues.zh: 然而，胡佛的計畫卻完全適得其反。

cues.text: Other countries retaliated by taxing American goods,
cues.en: Other countries retaliated by taxing American goods,
cues.zh: 其他國家對美國商品 加徵關稅作為報復，

cues.text: leading exports to fall and global trade to decline.
cues.en: leading exports to fall and global trade to decline.
cues.zh: 導致美國出口下滑， 全球貿易也隨之萎縮。

cues.text: In the end, this policy led American prices to spike
cues.en: In the end, this policy led American prices to spike
cues.zh: 最後，這項政策不但造成 美國物價大幅上漲，

cues.text: and caused even more unemployment.
cues.en: and caused even more unemployment.
cues.zh: 還導致更多人失業。

cues.text: These disastrous outcomes of the Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act
cues.en: These disastrous outcomes of the Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act
cues.zh: 這些災難性的結果， 其實並不令人意外，

cues.text: were no surprise to the over 1,000 economists
cues.en: were no surprise to the over 1,000 economists
cues.zh: 因為當時已有超過千名經濟學家 公開反對這項法案。

cues.text: who publicly condemned the bill.
cues.en: who publicly condemned the bill.
cues.zh: 但這並非絕響，後來還有世界領袖 也因關稅帶來的後果而大感意外。

cues.text: But this wouldn’t be the last time a world leader was shocked
cues.en: But this wouldn’t be the last time a world leader was shocked
cues.zh: 但這並非絕響，後來還有世界領袖 也因關稅帶來的後果而大感意外。

cues.text: by a tariff's consequences.
cues.en: by a tariff's consequences.
cues.zh: 那麼，關稅究竟是什麼？

cues.text: So, what exactly is a tariff?
cues.en: So, what exactly is a tariff?
cues.zh: 那麼，關稅究竟是什麼？

cues.text: A tariff is a tax an importer pays to bring foreign goods into a country.
cues.en: A tariff is a tax an importer pays to bring foreign goods into a country.
cues.zh: 關稅是進口商將外國商品 帶進一個國家時必須繳納的稅。

cues.text: For example, if they import $1,000 worth of goods at a 10% tariff rate,
cues.en: For example, if they import $1,000 worth of goods at a 10% tariff rate,
cues.zh: 例如，如果進口商以 1,000 美元的價格 進口商品，而關稅稅率是 10%，

cues.text: they'll pay $100 to the government in addition to $1,000 to the seller.
cues.en: they'll pay $100 to the government in addition to $1,000 to the seller.
cues.zh: 他除了要付給賣方 1,000 美元之外， 還要向政府繳交 100 美元的關稅。

cues.text: Foreign exporters could respond to a tariff by reducing their product’s price
cues.en: Foreign exporters could respond to a tariff by reducing their product’s price
cues.zh: 面對關稅，外國出口商 可能會降低產品價格，

cues.text: to keep an importer’s business.
cues.en: to keep an importer’s business.
cues.zh: 以留住進口商這個客戶。

cues.text: But if they don’t, importers bear this cost
cues.en: But if they don’t, importers bear this cost
cues.zh: 如果出口商不願降價， 這筆成本就會由進口商承擔，

cues.text: and then increase their prices so consumers will make up the difference.
cues.en: and then increase their prices so consumers will make up the difference.
cues.zh: 進口商接著會提高商品價格， 讓消費者來負擔這個差額。

cues.text: This may sound straightforward,
cues.en: This may sound straightforward,
cues.zh: 乍看之下，這似乎很簡單，

cues.text: but enacting a tariff kicks off a complicated economic chain reaction.
cues.en: but enacting a tariff kicks off a complicated economic chain reaction.
cues.zh: 但一旦實施關稅，就會引發 一連串複雜的經濟連鎖反應。

cues.text: So to keep things simple,
cues.en: So to keep things simple,
cues.zh: 為了簡單說明，

cues.text: let's look at some examples from just one country
cues.en: let's look at some examples from just one country
cues.zh: 我們先看單一國家的例子，

cues.text: to explore some of the factors that make a tariff’s outcomes tricky to predict.
cues.en: to explore some of the factors that make a tariff’s outcomes tricky to predict.
cues.zh: 藉此瞭解為什麼關稅帶來的後果 往往很難預料。

cues.text: First, tariffs can be applied to different countries at different rates.
cues.en: First, tariffs can be applied to different countries at different rates.
cues.zh: 首先，關稅可能會因進口商品的 來源國不同，而採用不同的稅率。

cues.text: For example, in 2024,
cues.en: For example, in 2024,

cues.text: America had a 6% tariff on all wool entering the country.
cues.en: America had a 6% tariff on all wool entering the country.
cues.zh: 美國對所有進口羊毛課徵 6% 的關稅。

cues.text: However, if that wool came from Mexico or South Korea,
cues.en: However, if that wool came from Mexico or South Korea,
cues.zh: 不過，如果羊毛來自墨西哥或南韓，

cues.text: it would be tariff-free due to trade agreements.
cues.en: it would be tariff-free due to trade agreements.
cues.zh: 根據雙方的貿易協定，就可以免關稅。

cues.text: Meanwhile, importers getting wool from Russia could face a hefty 55.5% tariff.
cues.en: Meanwhile, importers getting wool from Russia could face a hefty 55.5% tariff.
cues.zh: 相較之下，從俄羅斯進口羊毛的進口商 得繳納高達 55.5% 的關稅。

cues.text: Policies like these might help domestic wool producers,
cues.en: Policies like these might help domestic wool producers,
cues.zh: 這樣的政策可能 對國內的羊毛生產商有利，

cues.text: or they might just encourage importers to buy from specific foreign producers.
cues.en: or they might just encourage importers to buy from specific foreign producers.
cues.zh: 也可能只是讓進口商 改向特定國家的生產商採購。

cues.text: Things get even trickier when trying to predict how tariffs impact jobs.
cues.en: Things get even trickier when trying to predict how tariffs impact jobs.
cues.zh: 當我們試圖預測關稅會如何 影響就業時，事情就更加複雜了。

cues.text: Sometimes the jobs they create come at a high cost.
cues.en: Sometimes the jobs they create come at a high cost.
cues.zh: 有時候，關稅所創造的 工作機會，代價其實相當高。

cues.text: In 2018, the US imposed a tariff on washing machines
cues.en: In 2018, the US imposed a tariff on washing machines
cues.zh: 2018 年，美國對進口洗衣機課徵關稅，

cues.text: that created 1,800 jobs
cues.en: that created 1,800 jobs
cues.zh: 創造了 1,800 個工作機會，

cues.text: and raised roughly $82 million in government revenue.
cues.en: and raised roughly $82 million in government revenue.
cues.zh: 也為政府帶來大約 8,200 萬美元的稅收。

cues.text: However, it also increased the average price of washing machines by $86,
cues.en: However, it also increased the average price of washing machines by $86,
cues.zh: 然而，這項政策也讓洗衣機的 平均價格提高了 86 美元，

cues.text: costing consumers roughly $1.5 billion.
cues.en: costing consumers roughly $1.5 billion.
cues.zh: 讓消費者多支出約 15 億美元。

cues.text: This means consumers paid roughly $817,000 to create each of those jobs.
cues.en: This means consumers paid roughly $817,000 to create each of those jobs.
cues.zh: 換句話說，為了創造這些工作機會，

cues.text: In other cases, the jobs tariffs create come at the cost of existing jobs.
cues.en: In other cases, the jobs tariffs create come at the cost of existing jobs.
cues.zh: 有些情況則是，關稅創造了新的工作， 卻也讓原有的工作消失。

cues.text: In 2002, the Bush administration imposed tariffs as high as 30%
cues.en: In 2002, the Bush administration imposed tariffs as high as 30%
cues.zh: 2002 年，布希政府對進口鋼鐵 課徵最高達 30% 的關稅。

cues.text: on imported steel.
cues.en: on imported steel.
cues.zh: 當時，美國鋼鐵業的就業人數 已經衰退了幾十年，

cues.text: Employment in US steel production had been decaying for decades,
cues.en: Employment in US steel production had been decaying for decades,
cues.zh: 當時，美國鋼鐵業的就業人數 已經衰退了幾十年，

cues.text: so by making foreign steel more expensive,
cues.en: so by making foreign steel more expensive,
cues.zh: 因此政府希望藉由 提高外國鋼鐵的價格，

cues.text: the tariff sought to create new jobs for US steel manufacturers.
cues.en: the tariff sought to create new jobs for US steel manufacturers.
cues.zh: 為美國鋼鐵製造商創造新的工作機會。

cues.text: Initially, the policy did slow down job loss.
cues.en: Initially, the policy did slow down job loss.
cues.zh: 起初，這項政策確實 減緩了失業的速度。

cues.text: But since US steel still cost more than pre-tariff foreign steel,
cues.en: But since US steel still cost more than pre-tariff foreign steel,
cues.zh: 然而，由於美國鋼鐵的價格 仍高於課徵關稅前的進口鋼材，

cues.text: domestic industries that used this material had to increase their prices.
cues.en: domestic industries that used this material had to increase their prices.
cues.zh: 使用鋼鐵作為原料的國內產業 也只好提高產品價格。

cues.text: This made their products less competitive internationally,
cues.en: This made their products less competitive internationally,
cues.zh: 這讓它們在國際市場上的競爭力下降，

cues.text: where foreign manufacturers were still using cheap steel.
cues.en: where foreign manufacturers were still using cheap steel.
cues.zh: 因為外國製造商仍然使用便宜的鋼材。

cues.text: Within a year of enacting the tariff,
cues.en: Within a year of enacting the tariff,
cues.zh: 一年之內，美國在鋼鐵相關產業 流失的工作機會，

cues.text: the US lost far more jobs in steel-related industries
cues.en: the US lost far more jobs in steel-related industries
cues.zh: 一年之內，美國在鋼鐵相關產業 流失的工作機會，

cues.text: than they gained in steel-producing industries.
cues.en: than they gained in steel-producing industries.
cues.zh: 就遠遠超過鋼鐵生產業 所新增的工作機會。

cues.text: Clearly, how other countries respond to tariffs
cues.en: Clearly, how other countries respond to tariffs
cues.zh: 顯然，其他國家如何回應關稅，

cues.text: is another big part of the ripple effect these policies have.
cues.en: is another big part of the ripple effect these policies have.
cues.zh: 也是這些政策所引發 連鎖效應中的重要一環。

cues.text: One clear example comes from 2018,
cues.en: One clear example comes from 2018,
cues.zh: 2018 年就有一個很清楚的例子。

cues.text: when the US attempted to address its trade deficit with China
cues.en: when the US attempted to address its trade deficit with China
cues.zh: 當時，美國試圖透過 對中國商品課徵關稅，

cues.text: by taxing Chinese goods.
cues.en: by taxing Chinese goods.
cues.zh: 來改善美中之間的貿易逆差。

cues.text: While these tariffs protected domestic businesses
cues.en: While these tariffs protected domestic businesses
cues.zh: 這些關稅雖然保護了美國國內企業，

cues.text: and raised government revenue,
cues.en: and raised government revenue,
cues.zh: 也增加了政府收入，

cues.text: they also set off a trade war.
cues.en: they also set off a trade war.
cues.zh: 卻同時引發一場貿易戰。

cues.text: China retaliated by raising tariffs on US exporters,
cues.en: China retaliated by raising tariffs on US exporters,
cues.zh: 中國提高美國商品的 進口關稅作為報復，

cues.text: including farmers relying on Chinese markets for soybean sales.
cues.en: including farmers relying on Chinese markets for soybean sales.
cues.zh: 其中包括美國農民仰賴 中國銷售的黃豆。

cues.text: In the end, this led to higher prices for US consumers
cues.en: In the end, this led to higher prices for US consumers
cues.zh: 最後，這場貿易戰導致美國消費者 承受更高的物價，

cues.text: and a slight drop in America's GDP.
cues.en: and a slight drop in America's GDP.
cues.zh: 也讓美國的國內生產毛額 （GDP）小幅下降。

cues.text: Trade wars aren’t new.
cues.en: Trade wars aren’t new.
cues.zh: 貿易戰並不是新鮮事。

cues.text: And even in the 18th and early 19th centuries,
cues.en: And even in the 18th and early 19th centuries,
cues.zh: 在 18 世紀和 19 世紀初，

cues.text: when certain tariffs did help struggling industries find their domestic footing,
cues.en: when certain tariffs did help struggling industries find their domestic footing,
cues.zh: 即使某些關稅政策確實有助 陷入困境的產業在國內站穩腳步，

cues.text: they were mostly used to raise government funds.
cues.en: they were mostly used to raise government funds.
cues.zh: 關稅最主要的用途仍是增加政府收入。

cues.text: But over the last 200 years,
cues.en: But over the last 200 years,
cues.zh: 但過去 200 年來，

cues.text: our global economy has become far more interdependent.
cues.en: our global economy has become far more interdependent.
cues.zh: 全球經濟的相互依賴程度 已經大幅提高。

cues.text: Today, there are more manufacturing components
cues.en: Today, there are more manufacturing components
cues.zh: 如今，各國進口的 製造零元件之多，更甚以往，

cues.text: being imported than ever before,
cues.en: being imported than ever before,
cues.zh: 如今，各國進口的 製造零元件之多，更甚以往，

cues.text: many of which are used to make a wide variety of consumer goods.
cues.en: many of which are used to make a wide variety of consumer goods.
cues.zh: 而其中許多零元件又會被用來 製造各式各樣的消費商品。

cues.text: This complexity means that even a seemingly simple tariff
cues.en: This complexity means that even a seemingly simple tariff
cues.zh: 這種複雜的經濟關係意味著，

cues.text: can trigger a global chain reaction,
cues.en: can trigger a global chain reaction,
cues.zh: 即使看似簡單的一項關稅， 也可能引發全球性的連鎖反應，

cues.text: creating more consequences than anyone can plan for.
cues.en: creating more consequences than anyone can plan for.
cues.zh: 造成遠超乎預期的後果。
